notes.title: Small gameplay changes
notes.content:
[h1]Small gameplay changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Optimization at all levels.
[*] We balance the stats of the materials.
[*] We changed the difficulty of some levels.
[*] We add new achievements.
[/list]

Despite lowering the difficulty, it is still 100% impossible for you to win the game. ːLIS_pixel_heartː
